fitness.reason: The system demonstrates retrieval, grounded output and budget enforcement on a historical catalog. Top-five misses, incomplete synthesis and semantic errors limit reliable product recommendations.

failures.change: Retrieve a larger pool, group candidates by product, and rerank on explicit constraints before forming the context. Evaluate the change against the frozen benchmark.

observations.detail: The shortlists covered every required fact across chunks. Qwen selected one chunk, then the reviewer rejected it.
The answer cited the included trimmer. Its only quote lacked both time values, which were retrieved in a second chunk.

failures.change: Group evidence by document and required property. Allow multiple verified citations per product and partial responses marked as incomplete.

failures.mode: Semantic and citation-binding errors during generation

observations.detail: Ergo was accepted even though the quote states two compartments; the query requires three.
A three-seat sofa was accepted for a one-seat request despite the explicit count in its quote.
The 52 mm wide-angle query was refused with both annotated chunks in the first two ranks.
The same query and context produced different decisions in the two recorded runs; the cause was not isolated.
The paraphrase retained the same retrieved chunks. Both generated selections used evidence IDs belonging to other chunks, so verification prevented a final recommendation.

failures.change: Verify explicit model IDs, dimensions and counts deterministically when catalog metadata supports them. Tie each requirement to a quote, and replace separate model-written chunk and evidence fields with a single allowed evidence ID mapped to the chunk in code.

late_fact_anchors.verbatim: Ice Cube Tray Type: Twist Ice Maker

encoder_limit.interpretation: The dense encoder sees only the prefix. Full text remains available to BM25 and excerpt extraction. The audit does not isolate truncation as the cause of individual ranking misses.

annotation_notes.detail: The response contained the gold model and another catalog variant with matching side-window placement and easy removal. Exact product-set mismatch alone does not imply semantic error.
The alternative record has six vents and a ratchet harness. It does not establish that its chin strap is adjustable; it is listed as a fire-fighting helmet.

Chunk 0002 has the punctuation variant 'Weight: 2177 g'. Gold labels stayed frozen, so the literal source-group diagnostic counts only the annotated form 'Weight 2177 g'. The returned quote includes the weight but omits the requested plating.

hardening.proposal: Keep the structured response schema, context-scoped allowlist and pre/post price validation. Treat the user query as data and map a single allowed evidence identifier to its chunk in deterministic code so the model cannot combine mismatched IDs.
hardening.reason: No probe achieved its requested override. The proposed evidence-ID change addresses the reproduced non-adversarial pairing errors and was left outside this baseline.
